// Symbols that no project may use, checked by Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.BannedApiAnalyzers (RS0030).
// Format: {documentation comment ID};{message}

// The clock is injected, so that tests control the time.
P:System.DateTime.Now;Use the injected TimeProvider.
P:System.DateTime.UtcNow;Use the injected TimeProvider.
P:System.DateTimeOffset.Now;Use the injected TimeProvider.
P:System.DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;Use the injected TimeProvider.

// Native declarations are generated by CsWin32. Generated code is not analyzed (.globalconfig), so only a
// declaration written by hand is reported.
T:System.Runtime.InteropServices.DllImportAttribute;Declare the function in NativeMethods.txt: CsWin32 generates it.
T:System.Runtime.InteropServices.LibraryImportAttribute;Declare the function in NativeMethods.txt: CsWin32 generates it.
